What Next? v2.1.1-b75

Official Android Release | Build 75

What Next? is an unofficial AniList-powered anime and manga companion designed to help you discover, organise, track, and manage your anime and manga journey.

This release is being published as a fresh GitHub release following the removal of previous release entries. It provides a clean release record for build 75.

✨ About What Next?

What Next? goes beyond a traditional anime tracking application. It combines personalised recommendations, intelligent time-based suggestions, advanced library management, anime discovery, seasonal schedules, statistics, and social features in one application.

🌟 Main Features

  • Smart Recommendations: Discover anime and manga based on your personal interests, genres, themes, and AniList activity.
  • Time-Based Picks: Find something to watch or read depending on your available time.
  • Anime & Manga Tracking: Manage your Watching, Completed, Planning, Paused, Dropped, and Reading lists.
  • Advanced Discovery: Explore anime, manga, characters, staff, studios, and AniList users.
  • Seasonal Anime: Browse anime by release year, season, and format.
  • Release Calendar: Track upcoming episodes, premieres, and season finales.
  • Taste Reports: Analyse your preferences, favourite genres, themes, ratings, and viewing personality.
  • Detailed Statistics: Explore your anime and manga progress, ratings, genres, demographics, and activity.
  • Franchise Relation Maps: Explore connections between anime and manga franchises.
  • User Profiles: View AniList profiles, followers, following lists, and user statistics.
  • Private Messaging: Communicate with other AniList users through the built-in chat.
  • Advanced List Editor: Manage scores, progress, dates, rewatches, priorities, notes, favourites, and custom lists.
  • AniList & MyAnimeList Synchronisation: Advanced AniList Triple Sync functionality.
  • Offline Support: Access previously saved information when an internet connection is unavailable.
  • Personalisation: Anime-inspired themes, interface customisation, privacy options, and more.

📦 Release Information

🔐 Android Installation & Security

This APK is signed using the same Android signing certificate as the previous compatible builds.

Signing certificate SHA-256:

c2198c9ebde534385ad8bff490994676b9bebf74b550d36fb662bfe802a2cc72

  • Same application signing key.
  • Higher Android version code.
  • Release build rather than a standard debug build.
  • APK signing and version verification are performed during the build process.

Upgrade compatibility: Existing installations signed with the same certificate can be updated directly without uninstalling the previous version. Your existing application data should remain intact.

🔄 Important Notes

  • An AniList account is required to use the application.
  • This is an unofficial third-party AniList companion.
  • What Next? is not affiliated with or endorsed by AniList.
  • Certain advanced synchronisation features require users to configure their own API credentials.
